answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 3624 Country: India Title: Is it allowed for men to wear a silver bracelet? Kindly reply in detail. Question: Is it allowed for men to wear a silver bracelet? Kindly reply in detail. Answer ID: 3624 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 525/414=B) No, men can wear only silver rings weighing less than 1 misqal (=4.5 masha ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
